crossRefs.note: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose brothers were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

people.name: Elihu
people.line: A gatekeeper of the temple, son of Shemaiah.

people.name: Elzabad
people.line: A Korahite gatekeeper in the time of David.

people.name: Othni
people.line: Son of Shemaiah, gatekeeper of the ark

people.name: Rephael
people.line: A gatekeeper of the temple during David's reign

people.name: Semachiah
people.line: Son of Shemaiah, gatekeeper of the temple

translations.web: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose brothers were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
translations.bsb: Shemaiah’s sons were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad; his brothers were Elihu and Semachiah, also capable men.
translations.kjv: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
translations.asv: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
